    Research Associate

    <p>Dylan Marsh, M.S., is a Research Associate on the LIVE Project and a doctoral candidate in the Counseling Psychology Ph.D. program at Colorado State University. Beginning in Fall 2026, he will serve as an Assistant Professor of Counseling Psychology at Georgia State University. His research focuses on eudaimonic well-being with a particular interest in meaning and sense of calling in the work domain. More recently, his work explores how advances in artificial intelligence and automation in the workplace may impact the meaningfulness of work.</p>
